recommendations.action: Implement a standardized recipe and preparation guide for all dishes, conduct daily taste tests by a senior chef, and review ingredient suppliers for freshness and quality.
recommendations.expected_impact: Significant improvement in food consistency and overall customer satisfaction with taste and freshness.

recommendations.issue: Negative staff attitude (rudeness, unhelpfulness, lack of attentiveness).
recommendations.action: Develop and implement a mandatory customer service training program focusing on attentiveness, problem-solving, and positive communication. Increase management presence on the floor during peak hours for immediate feedback and support.
recommendations.expected_impact: Enhanced customer experience, improved staff morale, and reduction in negative service-related reviews.

recommendations.issue: Pricing perceived as too high or poor value for money.
recommendations.action: Conduct a competitive pricing analysis and re-evaluate menu item pricing. Consider offering value-added options (e.g., combo deals, larger portions for certain items) or clearly communicating the quality/sourcing of ingredients to justify prices.
recommendations.expected_impact: Improved perception of value, potentially increasing customer loyalty and reducing price-related complaints.

recommendations.issue: Frequent negative experiences related to unclassified aspects.
recommendations.action: Implement a customer feedback survey (e.g., QR code on tables, online form) specifically asking for open-ended comments on overall experience to identify recurring 'other' issues. Review detailed negative reviews for common themes not captured by existing categories.
recommendations.expected_impact: Uncover specific, hidden pain points to address, leading to a more comprehensive understanding of customer dissatisfaction.

recommendations.issue: Long wait times for seating, ordering, or receiving food.
recommendations.action: Optimize kitchen workflow and station assignments. Review staffing levels during peak hours and adjust schedules as needed. Implement a reservation system or a more efficient host stand process.
recommendations.expected_impact: Reduced customer wait times, leading to a smoother dining experience and improved operational efficiency.

recommendations.issue: Dissatisfaction with restaurant atmosphere or physical environment.
recommendations.action: Conduct a thorough review of the dining area's physical condition, including lighting, decor, and seating arrangements. Schedule regular maintenance and consider minor aesthetic upgrades to enhance comfort and appeal.
recommendations.expected_impact: A more pleasant and inviting dining environment, contributing to a better overall customer experience.

recommendations.action: Establish a detailed daily and weekly cleaning checklist for all areas (dining room, restrooms, kitchen). Assign specific staff responsibilities and implement regular management spot checks.
recommendations.expected_impact: A noticeably cleaner environment, improving customer comfort and perception of hygiene standards.
